nsd_username.description: Username to drop privileges to after binding socket.

nsd_zonesdir.description: The directory for zonefile: files. The daemon chdirs here.

nsd_zonelistfile.description: The list of dynamically added zones.

nsd_database.description: The database to use. If set to "" then no disk-database is used.

nsd_pidfile.description: File to store pid for nsd in.

nsd_round_robin.description: Round robin rotation of records in the answer.

nsd_minimal_responses.description: Minimal responses only emits extra data for referrals.

nsd_server_d_include.description: Optional local server config include path.

nsd_control_interface.description: Deprecated/unused in default config due to path usage. Kept for schema completeness if IP based control is ever used.

nsd_control_interface_path.description: Interface to listen to for remote control (path to unix socket).

nsd_control_port.description: Port number for remote control operations.
